completed_tasks.name: T10/T11 — Project votes + endorsements
completed_tasks.detail: POST/GET/DELETE /projetos/:id/votos; tipo=endorsement (Star) + tipo=voto (ThumbsUp); domain event PROJETO_ENDORSEMENT_RECEBIDO; UI buttons with aria-pressed, min-h-[44px]

completed_tasks.name: T4 — Rating eligibility gate
completed_tasks.detail: checkRatingEligibility(): mentor=always; curso/simulacao requires progressoPercentual>=30 from inscricaos collection; 403 if ineligible

completed_tasks.name: T8 — Vinculos isConnected filter bug
completed_tasks.detail: GET /perfis/:id: was using senderId/receiverId/estado='connected' (invalid fields) → fixed to solicitante[userId]/destinatario[userId]/status='aprovado' bidirectional. estudantes-vinculados endpoint fixed too.

remaining_tasks.name: N6 — Vocacional pesos por evento
remaining_tasks.detail: BFF loop is closed (persists to /perfil-vocacionals). Missing: event weights from spec 1a81656f, E2E validation with real Strapi. Check apps/api/src/routes/vocacional.ts and packages/shared/src/schemas/vocacional.ts

remaining_tasks.name: F6 — FOMO trigger notifications
remaining_tasks.detail: notify.hook.ts (4.4KB) exists but FOMO-specific triggers not implemented: '3 instituições viram o teu perfil', 'Perfil visitado X vezes esta semana', etc. Check apps/api/src/modules/hooks/notify.hook.ts

remaining_tasks.name: T9 — Notification grouping + agrupamento
remaining_tasks.detail: Socket.IO funcional for basic notifications. Grouping and real Push pending. Check apps/api/src/routes/notificacoes.ts

remaining_tasks.name: E4-T3 — Conquistas naming mismatch (D4)
remaining_tasks.detail: 12 conquistas with naming mismatch don't fire. Check apps/api/src/modules/conquistas/conquistas.engine.ts + conquistas.handler.ts. E2E: completion of simulacao 1 → 'Primeiro Passo' conquista at /estudante/conquistas

decisions.decision: T10 and T11 both implemented via same /projetos/:id/votos endpoint with tipo discriminator
decisions.rationale: VotoSchema already has tipo: 'endorsement'|'voto'; single endpoint is DRY and consistent

decisions.decision: T8 was a silent bug: isConnected was always false, causing visibility-protected fields to never show to connections
decisions.rationale: The Strapi vinculos schema uses solicitante/destinatario relations not senderId/receiverId flat fields

decisions.decision: T12 (Discussions) skipped — requires creating Strapi content types for discussion+reply collections first
decisions.rationale: No discussion/reply content-types exist in infra/strapi/src/api/ — too invasive without dedicated planning
